metadata.description: Sujeet's personal Claude Code toolkit: reusable plugins for any codebase

plugins.name: conventions
plugins.description: Portable coding conventions as path-scoped rules, installed into a project with /conventions:init

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Gate-based code review: one subagent per rule file, per-box PASS/FAIL verdicts, zero rationalized skips

plugins.name: claude-md
plugins.description: Audit a repo's Claude Code instruction setup: what stays in CLAUDE.md, what becomes a path-scoped rule, a skill, or a hook

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Verification workflows: look at the UI before calling it done, with realistic data across states, viewports and themes
